name: 80126 · Hghlnds Ranch, CO
findings: ZIP 80126 (Hghlnds Ranch) has 147 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80126 (Hghlnds Ranch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
